description: A five-row precision CV adder after the Doepfer A-185-2, each row added to, subtracted from or left out of a running total, with that total and its inverse on two jacks

params.text: Scales the volt that the first row's MODE switch adds or subtracts, 0 to 1V, so the first input can be trimmed by a fraction of an octave. Default 1, a whole volt
Chooses what the V knob's voltage does to the first CV IN: + adds it, - subtracts it, 0 leaves it out
Chooses what that row does to the total: + adds its CV, - subtracts its CV, 0 leaves the row out

inputs.text: The CV of the first row, which reaches the output whatever its MODE switch is set to; the switch governs only whether the V knob's voltage joins it
A CV added to or subtracted from the total according to that row's MODE switch; with nothing patched the row offers a flat 1V instead, so the switch transposes by an octave
Sets that row's MODE switch from a voltage: above 0V selects +, below 0V selects -, and only an exact 0V selects the middle position

outputs.text: The running total of the rows their MODE switches admit
The running total of the rows their MODE switches admit, with its sign flipped

notes: a voltage at a MODE CV jack is written straight into the switch, so the switch moves on the panel and stays wherever the CV last left it after the cable is pulled.
a row with nothing patched to its CV IN contributes anyway, a whole volt in the direction its MODE switch points, except the first row, which contributes the V knob's voltage instead.
